title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
original_title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
summary: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
title_zh: Grok Build 的分享链接暴露大量应用
lead_zh: Ars Technica 报道，研究者发现约 35000 个 Grok Build 应用可以被逐个找出来，其中包含 SpaceXSI 的敏感信息。随机链接并没有挡住枚举。
